# Business Insider

> Business Insider tells the global tech, finance, stock market,
> media, economy, lifestyle, real estate, AI and innovative
> stories you want to know.

Use individual articles as sources. When citing reporting,
include the article's title, author, publication or update
date, and canonical URL where available.

Check publication dates before treating figures, company
information, or descriptions of events as current.

Distinguish reported facts from analysis, opinion, forecasts,
and statements attributed to interviewees.

## Sections

- [Business](https://www.businessinsider.com/business)
- [Tech](https://www.businessinsider.com/tech)
- [Markets](https://markets.businessinsider.com/)
- [Lifestyle](https://www.businessinsider.com/lifestyle)
- [Military & Defense](https://www.businessinsider.com/defense)
- [Reviews](https://www.businessinsider.com/guides)
- [Video](https://www.businessinsider.com/video)
- [Community](https://www.businessinsider.com/community)
- [Newsletters](https://www.businessinsider.com/subscription/newsletter)
